notes.title: Weekly Report #17
notes.content:
[b]Hello![/b]

Today we have some really good news for you! A teaser of one of the most iconic locations from Zone, announcement of our contest’s winners and more information about a new character who will be able join Igor in his quest.

[b][h3]Pripyat Center incoming![/h3][/b]
We bet that’s the news you’ve all been looking for a long time! Pripyat Center is coming to Chernobylite - it’s a bigger area that also includes Lenin Square! We won’t reveal the exact date of release yet… but it’s going to be our Megapatch “Web of lies”! We’ve prepared a little video teaser: part of it was captured by our drones in Zone, but the other parts are locations from the game.

Check it out:
[previewyoutube=_oL-UxeBj6o;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]New mission “A voice in the woods”![/h3]
Olga is our new character which Igor will be able to recruit. She is a young woman living in a settlement deep in Red Forest and before joining Igor’s cause she’ll need his help with a delicate mission.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/643dd97180f085b2650e2b125fb48e39fb8a9c03.png[/img]

Her boyfriend, Kostya, is also a young stalker who went missing some time ago. And that can be no coincidence that it happened when NAR soldiers showed up precisely where he was supposed to look for supplies. So, Igor will have to decide about Olga & Kostya’s fate and you just have to know that it won’t be an easy mission.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/0f1535f8940a49631fe3a163f61e6b3ed940e7b3.png[/img]

[h3]Build your base contest: we’ve got the winners![/h3]
Choosing the winner was extremely difficult. You’ve send us dozens of great screenshots and while the competition was fierce we were amazed to see that our DevTeam jury gave similar scores to several bases.

And though we had to pick one main winner, we were really impressed with the amount of work and creativity you put in building your bases. That’s why we decided to award two other players with additional prizes: a set of T-shirt and a printed Artbook. We just had to appreciate your work. But to be honest, we had a really tough time choosing which bases we like the most.

Winners! Please contact us via [url=https://www.facebook.com/ChernobyliteGame/]Facebook fanpage[/url] or [url=https://twitter.com/chernobylgame]Twitter[/url] to confirm the shipment details.

So, now the grand moment…
The winner is… [b]Gökhan Şimşek![/b] He will receive our main prize - Main Hero Gas mask, T-shirt and Artbook. Congratulations, you really won our hearts!

Have a look at his base:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/463b609a242b712f0335e322c212a1fc73d96027.jpg[/img]
[url=https://twitter.com/Goksimsek16/status/1249075936550621188?s=20]More screens can be found here[/url].

The other two players who won a T-shirt and an Artbook are: sebs0109 and Noizebatch9.
Here’s sebs0109 work:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/6037c22d82032a906fcc0ae08efb59d20998894d.jpg[/img]
[url=https://www.instagram.com/p/B-yeMgrnt_s/]More screenshots from sebs0109 can be found here.[/url]

And here’s Noizebatch9 work:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/ca1494f3aa1314e09a37f6c26f35b461b1acea12.jpg[/img]
[url=https://www.instagram.com/p/B-qEflhAgwF]More screenshots from Noizebatch9 can be found here.[/url]

[b]That’s all for today. Congratulations again to the winners and see you next week![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/f61f60c06bc86706f02290ff438352e1b818481d.png[/img]

notes.title: Weekly report #13
notes.content:
[b]Hello![/b]

We hope that all of you are all right! The world is slowing down, cities are empty and people (hopefully) stay at home playing games and waiting for a better time to go outside. Did you know that the Chernobyl Exclusion Zone is now closed? Fortunately, you can still visit it in our game!

[h3][b]Home office challenge[/b][/h3]
Last week was a bit of a challenge for us. We had to face a huge logistics operation and take all of the necessary hardware to our homes, set up new working places there and get used to this whole new situation. At least that is what we can do. Once again - we are still working, not slowing down and trying to create as much content as we can despite the circumstances!

[h3]Quiet place… or not entirely?[/h3]
Not only the real world is empty and quiet. We are working on new in-game locations which are also forsaken and scary. Is this an empty playground? And an abandoned car? You may think you are safe when there is no-one around but what if someone is watching you from one of many of those windows? You will be able to find out pretty soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/0e330a8587713fd503f37d02909c6d8fa021538f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/ad73c2538029309686ca2532a3eafa1848772b7e.jpg[/img]

[h3]New character - Kozlov[/h3]
Meet our new character who we are working on right now. Kozlov - the perfect man of honor, has two faces - a grandfather, who loves to play with his grandson and a ruthless, efficient military commander. He believes in order, warrior’s honor and the nation. What role does he play in Igor’s life? Will he turn out to be a good or an evil person? Well, that is for you to find out soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/9ddc98b1bf3981978632382b01f8e12dd8bb3adc.jpg[/img]

[h3]Even more new enemies![/h3]
Last week we showed you a new monster from another dimension. Today we would like to introduce new human enemies - Soldiers. But wait, we already have some of them in the game? That is correct, but this time we've added new variants of soldiers that appear in later days and at higher difficulty levels. They are stronger and shoot more accurately.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/0d9d38a30a06ef73661e2ed5f8e6fb031676bcfa.png[/img]

[b]That is all for today! Stay safe and healthy guys. And one more time - please stay home! See you next week![/b]

notes.title: Weekly report #12
notes.content:
[b]Hello![/b]

We hope that all of you are safe and healthy. We also hope that you decided to stay home, while we keep preparing new content to enjoy. Today we will show you a sneak-peak with a new enemy  but let us begin with very important information.

[h3][b]Update regarding COVID-19 [/b][/h3]
First of all, we would like to calm you down - we do not stop working on the game. We take all the usual safety precautions, such as home office and avoiding personal meetings. Our field of operation lets us develop games remotely and safely. However, there might be some delays in publishing new patches. We kindly ask you for your patience as we all need to get used to this new situation. So, what are we currently working on? Let’s have a look.

[h3]New and cute enemy[/h3]
We like fighting monsters and trying to survive. But why should we limit ourselves and only have human-like enemies? Who does not love radioactive mutated spiders from another dimension? Covered in a cobweb of chernobylite, trying to surprise you jumping out of their nests? Just look at it, smiling to you! He’s our new cute&ugly dev team pet ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/db0701693f68c7a896965d2baba0bb1ae9f40b4b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/04e98407f1a751a0bfce0deaf3cf933eddaa7203.jpg[/img]

[h3]Working on gibs[/h3]
Something not very pleasant for your eyes but highly requested. In a short time, you will be able to unleash your fury and rip your enemies from their arms, legs or heads. As we do not want to be brutal and show you sensitive content here we only present colorless images. But you can imagine how do they look in the game - with full colors and shiny textures filled with horror.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/43044e7b334fb8a284600438c21d25973baa070b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/7b703b42761699e6fe606c0ea2dd0f62fc27e460.jpg[/img]

[h3]Tatyana investigation[/h3]
Our investigation will be like no other. You will be able to dive deep into the fractal world, look for clues and watch stories from the past. It is very mysterious but also really important for Igor and for you, as a player. We will not show you more of this for now. We will let your imagination work!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/4eb10552389fe305edc1319f0ddaa4cc0ff6eaeb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/de47576d27b075e216b9b801459540eb4ba60985.png[/img]


[b]Today we end without any funny memes. Please, stay home, watch Netflix, play games (Chernobylite of course!) and take care of each other. See you next week let’s hope healthy as never![/b]

notes.title: Major Patch - Game Quality Improvement Pass 2
notes.content:
[b]Improvements/Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] Various optimization works reduced the visual quality of the Moscow eye. We're working to improve it. The effects should be visible now.
[*] Many of you complain about the amount of slots available in the quick menu. So we increased their number from 4 to 8.
[*] After returning from the mission, many of you instead of going to sleep want to use the binoculars immediately after returning to the base. We've added a tutorial that should counteract this.
[*] Weapon modification should now be much more readable. While upgrading weapons, statistics are now displayed in the way that dynamically respond to applied upgrades.
[*] We have added new generic quests. From now on go yourself or send your companions for food, medicine and ammunition. You need to start a new game loop or a new game for them to appear.
[*] We've added miniquests in the base. Now your companions will ask you to solve their problems with the base, while teaching how it works.
[*] From now on, all crafting stations can be built only once. Thanks to this, it will be easier to know what we have already built and what we have not.
[*] We've added an indicator that clearly shows when you can perform takedown on your opponent.
[*] We've improved the notes handling system. Now you can zoom and move them to make them easier to read. But if someone still has problems reading them, we've added a system that displays standardized text in the appropriate language.
[*] We've improved the way we hold the revolver. Now it should be much easier to aim at.
[/list]

[b]General:[/b]
[list]
[*] Storage content should no longer disappear when a player dies. I hope this bug will never come back again…
[*] Now buildings built in the base should be correctly facing the player
[*] Character names in subtitles should no longer be displayed in black. Never.
[*] We have optimized sound banks. In addition to better performance, current build should be much lighter (over 2 GB) and future patches smaller.
[/list]

notes.title: Weekly report #11
notes.content:
[h3]Hello![/h3]
Good news everyone! Next week we’re planning to publish a new update - Game Quality Improvement Pass 2 which will contain a lot of visible changes. Also we’ve chosen the winner of the community vote contest! 

Now, let’s have a look on what’s coming next.

[b][h3]Visual boost on Moscow Eye[/h3][/b]
During the optimization process the graphic quality unfortunately decreased (which is normal at some stage of the process) and now we are implementing fixes to boost the quality of graphics on the Moscow Eye level so that FPS will stay good and the visuals will be pleasing to the eye again. The effects should be visible in the upcoming patch and it’s still work in progress. See for yourselves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/d5c7d2b41ccd519c29ab1efe1adbf2d8e2081ba4.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/6dbaf5facc73d2a6ebef5864544122443e35112e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/1f8d47ae224dce0d684a230c859f875f9d52dbb4.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Quick Menu expansion[/b][/h3]
After receiving many suggestions from the players about not enough slots in the quick menu we decided to expand the number of slots to 8. Now, you will be able to add more items you find useful without being forced to substitute other items instead. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/ea5032eb01ff06ad09f135b8ed7a02de8a03b099.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Weapon Upgrade system reworked[/b][/h3]
We made changes to the Weapon Upgrade UI which should be more readable now.  While upgrading weapons, statistics will be displayed in the way that dynamically responds to applied upgrades. We hope this will make upgrading your weapons easier and more pleasant.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/aac9bf54461ffd7bdb1b2ba00d6bc196073213f5.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Story Notes - improvements[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/f8b38deaa4973c2555f15bfa18fe5603630c9fa3.jpg[/img]

Sometimes the notes you find in the game can be a little bit hard to read for some people. After all, they are often very old documents on which time has left its mark. That’s why we made some changes in this matter. Soon you will be able to zoom and move a note which will make it easier to read. But if someone would still have problems after all, there will be a new system that displays standardized text in the appropriate language.
This way you will be able to sink into the story more pleasantly ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/2001fe2fb444cc65b4ac4314487d5429fb61693d.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/81476271fceeb6d9d56b723338013d58acb8910a.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Community Vote Contest Results[/b][/h3]
Last  but not least, we have chosen the winner of the last community vote contest! The choice was difficult because there were so many really really great answers. But we had to choose one so the winner is… Gökhan Şimşek for his really long and insightful reply about Pripyat Port! Congratulations!
We will reach out to the winner via Twitter. Thanks again everyone for your opinions and see you in the next community vote!

Winner tweet:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/20b0f8a8c1684e63e49bd374163521cfe3d659ac.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]#Friday[/b][/h3]

A couple of weeks ago there has been a tragedy. Tatyana’s red dress has gone missing after all this time it served us on various events. Fortunately, we have a spare one, but after all, it’s a shame. 
BUT! We conducted an investigation with a search party and looks like we have our suspect! This guy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/0ae43689e0e928db4c88f90da00b2f4365fd2089.png[/img]

Not only he’s a scary guy following your steps, but also female garment thief. You should really watch out for him.

That's all for today! See you next week!

notes.title: Major Patch - Game Quality Improvement Pass 1
notes.content:
[b]Improvements/Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] We have significantly improved the appearance of the Main Menu. New version may have minor problems and bugs, but overall, it is close to its final form.
[*] In building and crafting menus we added information on whether and how many objects of the given type we have already built.
[*] We improved the appearance and lighting of the character. They should have more detail now.
[*] UI for investigation board has been improved graphically
[*] We've added support information that encourages you to address base issues before going to bed.
[*] We added 3 starting perks that tell you about Igor's skills at the beginning.
[*] Many people did not notice the tutorials, which later caused them problems and confusion with the game. Now pop-ups should be definitely more noticeable, although they still do not stop the game.
[*] We introduced a lot of improvements to Level Design related to Power Plant that should break the feeling of ubiquitous "invisible walls" a bit.
[*] We improved the quest draw system. Now, the ones associated with the plot should appear much more often.
[*] Many of you don't know that instead of dying while fighting soldiers, you can just give up and let them capture you. We added a tutorial on how to do it.
[*] We've revised some of the texts in the Journal to make them easier to understand. We are still working on its quality.
[*] In the Journal, new graphics to skills are added. Now everything should be much more pleasing to the eye.
[*] On the second loop of the game Olivier now gives Igor adrenaline. It should make the game easier for those who often die.
[*] Inventory quality of life improvement. You don't have to click on it to see the item description anymore, just move the cursor on it.
[*] We have optimized the operation of videos, we also discarded old prototypes. Thanks to this the build should be almost a gigabyte smaller.
[/list]

[b]AI: [/b]
[list]
[*] We added voice system to AI soldiers. Now they should respond verbally to the player's actions. This prototype may not work very well yet, and VOs are placeholders.
[*] The opponents should behave much better when player disappears from their view. They no longer use suicide rush and don't shoot everything around them blindly.
[*] We've improved the opponents' threat meter. Now opponents react more dynamically to his acquisition.
[*] The way soldiers aim for the player are more polished. Fighting with several soldiers should be a bit easier now.
[*] We eliminated a bug in the path system that caused frequent game crashes.
[/list]

[b]General:[/b]
[list]
[*] The problem generating crashes in Free Play mode is fixed.
[*] We detected an error that caused some data to remain in memory despite starting a new game.It was probably responsible for all very rare and difficult replication errors, such as a broken radiation gate or a disappearing portal generator.
[*] The problem with objects jumping between storage should no longer occur. Only new storage will work properly! If you don't want to start a new game, then demolish the old and create a new one. Thanks to everyone who overwhelm us with all storage problems.
[*] The error that caused endless falling loop (occurs during takedown and low health animation) should not occur anymore.
[*] We have removed old prototype remains from the build menu
[*] We fixed some errors with inventory positioning. We also added signatures.
[*] During the "Meeting with Tarakan" quest, special effects should now activate correctly.
[*] Problem with the inability to interact with items, because the player is in combat, although all opponents are no longer alive, should no longer occur.
[*] Kopachi Vagabond event should no longer block the game.
[*] Dialog menu should no longer conflict with other interface elements.
[*] Chernobylite and Portal Generator now have final icons.
[*] The log now shows us the number of crafted ammo correctly.
[*] During training with Mikhail there were still remains from the first day on the level that made it difficult to focus on the task. Now, it’s fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Weekly Report #9
notes.content:
[h3]Hello![/h3]
Our bug fixing offensive is in its bloom and our last week’s main focus was specifically on improving and fixing all the old and new issues.

After the last update we realized that we should pay more attention to stability when adding new content and changes. Early Access game is a living organism and breaking things affects all our player community so it requires care and thorough tests. We took all your recent reviews very seriously and decided to put almost all our manpower to fix bugs and problems.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/72901a090401d79cad83a73f0e92900c35db58db.jpg[/img]

The first fruit of our labour was the recent major update which solved some problems with CPU and FPS drops, save system, the starting mission, some animations and began the process of rebuilding Moscow Eye to improve its performance. The full list of changes is here:

https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791463995837/announcements/detail/3744117349102512645

[h3]Plans on what’s next[/h3]
In the following weeks we will be focusing on improving and fixing e.g. elements of the soldier’s AI, UI (Inventory, Base Building, Tutorials), skill trainings or perk system and, of course, we’ll continue to optimize the game. 

Let us know how the recent changes worked for you on our Steam forum. The more details you give us the better! :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/140434085bbf381d68537bfee81ffaa12df42720.jpg[/img]

[h3]It’s community vote time![/h3]
Reviews and forum discussions are one way of learning what you think. But now, we want to add something else. From now on we will be making regular surveys on our social media to learn more globally what things you like about our game. Today we launched our first one on Twitter:

Which of these locations is your favourite and why?
https://twitter.com/ChernobylGame/status/1230853230709657607

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/98ed319709f3ee33d91ed388504b96f90513464d.jpg[/img]

All you need to do is choose the place you feel is best in your opinion, and, if you like, share some thoughts why you think so in the comments section.

Now here’s a treat for that! The most interesting answer will win a Chernobylite T-shirt, Artbook and a printed bundle from the game![b] The poll ends on Wednesday 26 February 2020. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/2b7bfc7537f6eac613f0a6ae6744678b384ed99f.jpg[/img]

Rules of the contest:  http://www.thefarm51.com/chernobylite-contest-rules/

[h3]#Friday[/h3]
Last Thursday was one of the best days in the whole year - it was Fat Thursday! It’s a special day before the Lent when everyone eat as many donuts as they can. Poland specializes in amazing donuts with various fillings - marmalade, cream, pudding, chocolate - well literally everything!

Our team of course needed energy to keep up the pace and keep fixing the game, so we got a whole bunch of tasty donuts to fill our bellies and heal all those negative emotions with sugar! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/d067a0f82ae17371c43c6a3b7f9669f06c5a9bdb.jpg[/img]

And what is magical about this day it that all the calories from those donuts go exactly where you want them to - NOWHERE! At least this is what people believe after eating their 5th donut… But you know…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/3fcf847deb5d31ca90e87ace73ac45524be2c6f6.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Major Update - Lots of optimization and bug fixing
notes.content:
[b]Improvements/Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] We've added the save versioning system. Now you will be informed when save may not be compatible with the latest changes.
[*] We have added a popup that forces confirmation of the will to delete storage filled with items.
[/list]
[b]Optimization:[/b]
[list]
[*] Optimization of audio content has significantly reduced the size of the game. Build should weigh almost 2 GB less.
[*] Optimization of the CPU and many global settings should greatly increase the FPS of the game. Unfortunately, this was associated with the need to create settings again. If you have significantly modified the game settings (such as advanced graphics options or key mapping), then you will have to do it again.
[*] There have been problems with the Moscow Eye for a long time. This was our first level and object of many tests. To significantly increase its efficiency, we decided to build it again. Not everything is finished yet, some places may be bugged or look ugly, but the level itself works MUCH better than before. We will continue to work on improving its quality.
[/list]

[b]Localization:[/b]
[list]
[*] Language version has been updated for: Hungarian, French, Turkish
[/list]

[b]General:[/b]
[list]
[*] Starting mission should no longer have a problem with FPS drop
[*] Benchmark should now display the average frame rate correctly.
[*] Olivier should no longer stutter during the starting mission. At least he promised to improve very much.
[*] Mikhail should now appear correctly in the base after using "alternate memories"
[*] Quest markets should no longer break in free play mode
[*] Problem with the disappearing loot icon has been resolved
[*] We've improved resources that appeared off the map.
[*] Fixed an issue where soldiers sometimes walked in a very strange way.
[*] Gesture animations and idle animations have been improved for many. Much is yet to come ...
[/list]

notes.title: Weekly Report #8
notes.content:
[h3]Hello![/h3]
[b]
First of all, happy Valentine’s Day![/b] Since love is an important subject in our game, we simply could not resist this ;) We hope that by the next Valentine’s Day Igor will solve the mystery about his beloved Tatyana. And so will you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/7238a2607b22578b0d58abd00788f99c98cfbd3f.jpg[/img]

Now, let’s move on to our last week’s recap.

[b][h3]Fixes Fixes Fixes![/h3][/b]
Last week was veeeery busy for us because we were rushing with fixes to the problems you encountered after the latest mega patch. Big thanks to all of you who reported us their issues. Thanks to you we were able to trace many of them and fix them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/13f8f87e9624b4d2e4c6f1b2ddf9266904cb251d.png[/img]

Developing a game can be a really tricky process. Changes and adding new things can cause other things, which used to work so far to stop doing it. We’re very sorry for those problems you faced and we really take all feedback, even negative to our hearts.

There were a couple of hotfix patches released after the patch, so here’s a summary of what has changed with full lists of fixes for those who want to dive deeper:

https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791463995837/announcements/detail/1710741388958487135
https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791463995837/announcements/detail/1710741388944242460
https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791463995837/announcements/detail/1710741388940713545

[b][h3]Man does not live by fixes alone[/h3][/b]
But this was not only we’ve been working on lately. Some of you probably noticed on our social media some sneak peeks of the new location - The Lenin Square. It’s the place with the famous Energetik Palace and a nearby Amusement Park with even more famous Ferris Wheel. We scanned lots of things and places from there and now we’re finally implementing them into the game. Have a look!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/f64138f53cee5443b52ea113bd22b797b03d7b0e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/476977cf9a773634cdc9935ba2a79f1a9e4afe7e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/1edd78c3df3d741fbd020d70167566e34f108965.jpg[/img]

Oh and this is us there on one of our many many trips to Chernobyl :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/df4c04129133e8ffb8a8ee29ff6912c54eddddf9.jpg[/img]
[i]Our hardcore Chernobyl veteran team ;) Some of them can’t even count how many times they’ve been there.[/i]

[b][h3]Making off goodie[/h3][/b]
Have you seen those electric cars in the amusement park? Let’s make a quick comparison between a real photo and a 3D scan. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/034c81868f5cb553c5f452a38231a26d05d373aa.jpg[/img]

Find 3 differences ;)

[b][h3]# Friday[/h3][/b]
Sometimes when working on WIP levels, those poor, hard-working PCs can sometimes really gasp for air and one needs to look for all help possible. Unfortunately, this patient died anyway ;(

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/d6f2f444efe7e4c0ca7dad0b9a7d71ed07f198f5.jpg[/img]

That’s it folks! See you next week!

notes.title: Chernobylite Megaupdate #3 - “Old Friend” Changelog
notes.content:
Hello guys,
behold, our first of many story-related updates is finally live! “Old Friend” is the biggest update we’ve prepared so far. There will be many new quests, dozens of events, quite a lot of improvements and accessories for weapon crafting. All this sprinkled with many fixes, visible optimization and redesigns of those elements, which you had objections to.
Today, Chernobylite is about 50% bigger than at the launch. We hope that those players who put our game aside in the last couple of months will give it another try and will like what they see. We’re perfectly aware that we still have a long way ahead of us filled with lots and lots of mega patches until the game is finished. But we really feel that after those very difficult months we’re heading towards the end holding our heads high and we hope you will walk with us along the way.

[previewyoutube=vsk0XoClAGk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Improvements/Additions:[/b][/h3]
[h3]Quests added:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New quest “Old Friend” (new chain - Georgiy).
[*] New quest “Power Plant’s Plans” (part of Georgiy chain).
[*] New quest “Secret Storage” (part of Olivier chain).
[*] New quest “Hermit” (part of Mikhail chain).
[*] New quest “Big Fish” (part of Mikhail chain).
[/list]
[h3]Other:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Events: Pripyat port has been filled with events.
[*] Events: Kopachi has been filled with events.
[*] Combat: Soldiers now fire more often. No-hit effects are visible in the environment.
[*] AI: Black Stalker can now be defeated in battle and driven out of the level.
[*] AI: Appearance of the Black Stalker is also associated with time anomalies. Igor and Black Stalker move normally, and the rest of the world stops.
[*] Crafting: Added an Assault Rifle upgrade system.
[*] Crafting: Added a new crafting table. It can be used to upgrade the assault rifle.
[*] Difficulty: There will be far fewer opponents on easy and very easy mode. This should significantly facilitate the gameplay of those for whom Chernobylite was annoyingly difficult.
[*] A few lootable containers added on all levels.
[/list]

[h3]General:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the Level of Details and stuck spots (Thanks to our Community from Steam forums for suggestions!).
[*] Fixed FOV values causing Shotgun and AK to look badly (Thanks to @Fathom from Steam forums).
[*] Fixed various bugs with Storage Units (Thanks to our Community from Steam forums for suggestions).
[/list]

[h3]Optimization:[/h3]
The levels should load significantly faster.
Time spent in Hawking Tunnels should be significantly reduced.
We are currently working on optimizing the CPU. The overall game performance should be better.
Problems with the Moscow Eye performance should be significantly reduced. The level can still have problems, but we're on track to fix them.

[h3]Adrenaline Redesign [/h3]
Chernobylite from the beginning was to be a difficult game with elements that need to be repeated and mastered. Unfortunately, in some places of the game we have clearly exaggerated. Players often (also through no fault of their own, but due to EA errors) fail their mission, and are forced to perform it again, without the possibility of using alternative methods available only after the next pass. To limit this situation and make more players have access to new content, we modified the way adrenaline works. Now its use is not associated with mission failures, and additionally gives a special power-up that should help you get out of a difficult situation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/3f8fb785f33e6e26180ffcae2c066f0fb0d6475b.gif[/img]

[h3]Day limit[/h3]
Time loop in our game is very important - it allows you to make other choices in missions, unlock new companions, or discover new secrets by alternate memories. A small limit allows you to focus on the plot and quickly correct your mistakes. Bigger will let you focus more on survival and team. How to reconcile these two approaches? The easiest way is to give you a choice - now when starting a new game you can choose how many days a single time loop will take.

[h3][b]That’s all for this update. We hope you like the changes and don’t hesitate to write a review about our game and give us your comments and suggestions on our Steam forum.[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Weekly Report #7
notes.content:
[b]Hello![/b]

We have some good news to share! The next Mega Patch is planned to be launched next week! So in just a couple of days you will be able to push forward your investigations about Tatyana and check out all the quests we prepared.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/95fb82be9668b9c48ced730e106d098e1c8ff69e.jpg[/img]

But apart from story quests, which we discussed last time, this update will consist of other things, like changes to the gameplay. Let’s have a look at them now.

[h3]Adrenaline redesign[/h3]
Chernobylite was planned from the start to be a challenging game with many elements to be repeated and mastered. But at some points we were too harsh for the players who were forced repeat their missions due to bugs or simply due to some simple errors. So we came up with a solution and modified the way adrenaline works.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/3f8fb785f33e6e26180ffcae2c066f0fb0d6475b.gif[/img]

Now its use is not associated with mission failures, and additionally gives a special power up that should help you get out of a difficult situation.

[h3][b]Day limit - it’s up to you![/b][/h3]
Time loop in our game is very important - it allows you to make different choices in missions, unlock new companions, or discover new secrets by alternate memories. A small limit allows you to focus on the plot and quickly correct your mistakes. Bigger will let you spend more time on survival and your team. How to reconcile these two approaches? The easiest way is to give you a choice - now when starting a new game you can choose how many days a single time loop will take.

[h3][b]New items to craft[/b][/h3]
Recently we added a new weapon - Assault Rifle - to the game so some of you already tested it in action. Now it’s time for attachments and upgrades thanks to which you will be able to adjust your new weapon to your needs on a brand new crafting table! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/a00eb54e40d3a7a3997c86dd390821b288dd4ef8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/38a40057aef37cc29443a1b0d3072269dcd42f1e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/c6a71fff4b1e3d0bc4ae0c1959d9f527c88b89e0.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Making of extra goodie[/b][/h3]
Remember our Kickstarter campaign? The ultimate reward we offered to our backers was the Eternal Fame Edition which included 3D scanning and including the backer’s scan into the game. We’re currently working on their models and here’s one of them. Nice isn’t it?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/0481bc0e08a5729d6d627028b5f445dd21f3aa98.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/2d8ac2253bf097bb5ffe6fb5513b705030afb4f5.png[/img]

[b]That’s it for today! See you next week![/b]

notes.title: Weekly Report #6
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hey guys![/b][/h3]

Here’s some fresh news right from the oven. In today’s report we want to tell you a few words about new story quests which we’ve been working on for the last few months and also some changes on Kopachi and Pripyat Port levels. We’re planning to add them soon, some in the next mega patch and some soon after.

[b]Oh and in case you haven’t noticed, Chernobylite is now on sale until January 27! Those who are interested to visit the Chernobyl Zone themselves, now it’s your chance at a lower price![/b]
Now, back to development news ;)

[h3][b]STORY QUESTS[/b][/h3]

The next mega patch is right around the corner and along with it, you will be able to check out new quests related to Olivier, Mikhail or the new character - Georgiy. Of course, we don’t want to spoil you anything so let’s have a look at brief descriptions of the quests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/932e9f4fc8533d0fd9bfe79e01b8a6af0362fc4a.png[/img]

[b]SECRET STORAGE (Olivier)[/b]
Olivier overheard NAR chatter on the radio about a stash in Kopachi next to Pripyat River. He asks Igor to check it out and bring some valuable supplies for the base.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/cf6a59e8a005677b08e60795a59c2bfb8256f9c4.png[/img]

[b]HERMIT (Mikhail)*[/b]
Mikhail, contacted by his good friend who is in deep trouble with the NAR, asks Igor for a favour to find this friend in Pripyat Port and check if he is alright. Will Igor help this mysterious person?

[b]BIG FISH (Mikhail)*[/b]
Mikhail approaches Igor and tells him that someone very important will be visiting Kopachi village. Alas, a big fish, who may have some vital information, is heavily guarded by soldiers. Mikhail asks Igor to go to Kopachi and get his hidden weapon which will help Igor deal with the soldiers.

[i]*You need to have Mikhail on your team to do this quest.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/7c60dd0dee03537c6c31310721b157cb57b3f0ee.png[/img]

[b]OLD FRIEND (Georgiy)[/b]
Igor heard soldiers talking on the radio about some Professor Georgy Semonov who will be soon in Kopachi kindergarten. Igor knew once a man by this name, his mentor, many many years ago. Will this be a chance to meet an old friend from the past?

[b]POWER PLANT PLANS (Georgiy)[/b]
One day Igor’s radio picks a mysterious looped recording. He has some documents for Igor hidden in the Pripyat Hospital which many contain an important clue for the investigation. This may be a breakthrough!


[h3][b]New events in locations[/b][/h3]

Story quests are not the only thing that are coming soon to the game. We’re also filling the levels which are currently a bit empty with new events! Most of them will add a little weirdness and creepiness to Kopachi and Pripyat port. Some will involve dolls, some shadows, stalkers or Tatyana.  

[b][h3]Making of extra goodie[/h3][/b]
Have you ever wondered how a raw 3D scan looks like while it’s rendering? Have a look at this building. Anyone recognizes what it is? That’s a tricky one but a true stalker will know ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/dd5e22f6b374cbfba86e38de16365fe6ba9eebe8.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/9139d65614c9e9c5e0073412202c9d2db25ef5ff.jpg[/img]

And when a 3D scan is properly prepared, rendered and cleaned, the effects can be stunning. This gym is just a WIP version and requires still a lot of reworking, but looks awesome already isn’t it?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/1649b5700f2a1b13203b74746f64b38cfd8ba801.jpg[/img]

That’s is for today, see you next week!

notes.title: WEEKLY REPORT #5
notes.content:
[h2]Hello![/h2]
Happy New Year everyone! Did you make any resolutions? For us it’s going to be a challenging year with many updates to go and now we would like to share our first report this year with news from behind the scenes!

Apart from polishing the things you’ve reported to us so far, we’re focusing on preparing content for the next Mega Patch we planned on our roadmap.

notes.title: Mega patch - Red Forest
notes.content:
[h2]Hello![/h2]
Most of you are thinking about Christmas and presents, and we prepared something special for you as well! Just as promised in the Roadmap, we would like to introduce Red Forest Mega Patch! Merry Christmas everyone! ;)
Have a look on what you may find in the update below.

[h2]Behold, Red Forest is here![/h2]
The last weeks were devoted mainly to the new location called “Red Forest”. We’ve been teasing you with screenshots for some time, and now the moment has come! The gates are now open and you can explore the place yourselves.
We hope you like it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/9e22093e0b2303682531d036773ae4d8618f28fd.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/af283884b33fcaa30f5a7ee0158b2dcb1c12d7ac.jpg[/img]

[h2]Changes in the Base[/h2]
[h3]Feeding system redesigned[/h3]
We received a lot of feedback regarding the feeding system, that’s why we decided to redesign it completely. Thanks to you we knew what to change so now the system should be more intuitive and transparent. Let us know what you think of it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/dc23a5c2dd9dbc373666cc9b7370631990d642cf.jpg[/img]

[h3]Storage changes[/h3]
Weapon cabinet and Pantry have a visual representation of the objects stored in it. Now you can see your things inside them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/4858ab0c6a23eaa412e5703be63082f513cbda61.jpg[/img]

[h2]Free Play Mode[/h2]
As mentioned in our last Weekly Report, we introduced the Free Play Mode which will allow you to choose any location in a selected weather configuration. You will also be able to choose from the missions available in that location, turn random events on or off or even start the game with all available weapons and skills! 

Important: After the day ends, the game will automatically return to the main manu, so treat this mode as a test field for you.


[h2]Framerate improvements[/h2]
We kept on working on optimization and we’re consequently moving forward! Players with lower PC specs should notice a significant improvement in framerate. We hope this will make the game more enjoyable for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/1636e56d40210cab18e97e7e2d40115ef27b8553.jpg[/img]

[h2]Lots of fixes![/h2]
[list][*] Fixed problems with water visualisation
[*] Fixed problem with Sashko accomplishing his task before being assigned to it
[*] Various fatal errors are now fixed. Thank you for your reports and keep on sending us your logs and saves!
[*] Fixed problems with item storage in the base.
[*] Fixed error with weapon upgrade display in other languages than English.
[/list]

[h2]Christmas Streams![/h2]
We wanted to meet with you once more before Christmas, and we will do this three times this week! You can meet us during streams on Steam on Wednesday at 2 PM CET, and on Thursday and Friday, 5 PM CET. There will be Christmas giveaways and contests! See you then!

notes.title: Weekly Report #4
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hi Everyone! [/b][/h1]
Another week - another weekly report with an update about the progress on the Mega Patch where you will find what to expect, and we hope that you will like the things we are going to present to you in the next update.

As per last report, we received a lot of feedback from you and we used that to make a huge progress to improve our game. 

Without further ado, let’s recap on what’s new: 

[b][h1]The Red Forest[/h1][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/afbfe70b322037f989564dcbdb59d70ae9b48ecd.png[/img]

Our work on the Red Forest is at the final stage. We are making the last corrections, also we are adding quests, events etc. Our testers are checking if everything is OK and we hope that you’ll enjoy the results. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/79946fb74a35ed827830d485986c7e1c6c4cfeed.png[/img]

[b][h1]Free Play Mode[/h1][/b]
We know for a fact, that many of you like to play very specific missions in our game. Therefore, we are working on a free play gamemode for you, in which you will be able to choose any location at your discretion in the selected weather configuration, to see how the place looks like in different weather variants. You will also be able to choose from the missions available in that location  and turn random events on or off so that they will not distract you during the playthrough. You will even be able to start the game with all available weapons and skills! 

This will allow you, among other things, to test the variations of missions and it will give our virtual photographers more freedom to prepare the environment for screenshots better. 

Important: After the day ends, the game will automatically return to the main manu, so treat this mode as a test field for you :) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/3119857480e6f53631e7585562118fdc528e4bbb.png[/img]

[b][h1]Optimization:[/h1][/b]
Of course, we have not forgotten about optimization! In the "Red Forest" update you can expect a slight increase in the smoothness of the game. We're working hard to make the game run better even on weaker configurations. This is not an easy task, but we are doing our best to make you happy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/d89c4ca2571558e62598b59b8f8b3b2046354ac4.jpg[/img]

[b][h1]Community:[/h1][/b]
If you like what we do, follow us on our social media. New "behind the scenes" materials and "beginners guide to chernobylite" are presented every week. Moreover, our Developer live streams will return next week! Again, you will have the opportunity to see our developers in action, ask questions or even win prizes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/0a1c508cd9c9c7196b1c2a042770a3c65e3d80f8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/cac77c8f5f4df5319e5c6d83554430e37fa86cfb.png[/img]

That’s all about this week report. 

[b][h2]See you next time! :) [/h2][/b]

notes.title: Weekly Report #3
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hi everyone! [/b][/h1]

Another week of work in the studio is behind us. We are working hard, in order to prepare new patches to fix some issues reported. Also we are making progress with the content for the next Mega-Patch. In addition, since the last report, we fixed the problems with the storage system and the shotgun you reported to us. Thank you for that! 

We see that the changes we make and the content we add are the things which you like. We recently received a large number of positive reviews, and we are grateful for that. 

Remember that everything we are working on, is to diversify and lengthen your gameplay. We want to give you freedom in terms of gameplay style.

[h1][b]The Red Forest[/b][/h1]

The preparation of the new level, The Red Forest, is at a really advanced stage. Our Level Designers are working hard on many aspects and are refining the elements of the map so you will see the effects of their work soon. In the meantime, we’ll show you a couple of screenshots of it to arouse your curiosity:  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/7317d006524aa24aac537b09d66c207d724bcd85.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/39c89cb66e6c365c001b118dcd1815d0c254f87a.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Food Ration Splitting[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/dffe8869aa18b4d26f3b8d86a9078af65f59c4d1.jpg[/img]


The Red Forest is not the only thing we are currently working on. The current system of sharing food with companions got a lot of mixed opinions, so we are testing new ways of making it more transparent both in terms of how it works, and the appearance of the interface. You can expect the refreshed version of this system in the next Mega-Patch.


[h1][b]Weapon Upgrade System[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/4ee3ccd05b1949c9d7390c559a352087ebdf9669.png[/img]

Our Community liked the Weapon Upgrade System, that was added in the previous Mega-Patch. Thank you very much for the really large amount of feedback. That leads us to the fact that in the near future we want to add more elements to it, so the possibilities of personalizing your weapon during the gameplay will be much greater. In addition, we are still improving the readability of the elements, and we want to introduce a system of indicators in the form of stripes, that will show you more precisely how your weapon parameters change in a given configuration.


[h1][b]Community:[/b][/h1]

Recently, new things have appeared in our social media.

[h1][b]BEGINNER'S GUIDE TO CHERNOBYLITE[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/db7ea65e8cca2e91dc3c971b961615668267d96c.jpg[/img]

On our Twitter account, you could see the first episode of the series called "Beginner’s Guide to Chernobylite" -  a weekly dose of simple information about what to expect during gameplay and about some game elements. Expect various surprises too!


[h1][b]BEHIND THE SCENES[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/d27f4b8e765fba0da518bd72323aaa3b876ef56b.png[/img]

We also returned to revealing the trivia about our project, in the form of "Behind the scenes". Every week on Facebook you will be able to learn something that you may not have had a clue about, or what you accidentally missed on our social media. Furthermore, you can ask questions and comment about this matter, which will allow us to create this type of content ahead of time to satisfy your curiosity.


[h1][b]DEV STREAMS ON STEAM[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/49484c628f41c2dffbbe71970913896f63f70fae.jpg[/img]

Also last week, we conducted a number of activities on Steam, in the form of Developer Live Streams, and our brave Devs played the game and answered Community Questions. During these struggles you could see, among others:
Artur - Our Technical Artist, 
Sławomir - Level Designer, 
Tomasz - Animator,
Sebastian - Lead Level Designer, 

and Krzysiek - our Community Manager. We also did a small giveaway with several codes and physical rewards. Keep an eye out for more of these activities in the future!

That's it for this week.

See you in the next weekly report!

notes.title: Weekly Report #2
notes.content:
[b]Hi There Everyone! [/b]

Next week, next Weekly Report! Here is the recap of things that changed during last week in game. 

First of all - On Tuesday we've released a Mega Patch called "Aftermath" with a lot of new content for you, couple of new mechanics as well as additions and corrections. 

You can check out the trailer for the patch here: 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5nbJM3sd8cI

[h1][b]New weapon: Assault rifle[/b][/h1]
Although our game is not focused on shooting as much as Metro or Stalker, you still cite these titles by complaining about the small amount of weapons in Chernobylite. You missed the fast-firing rifle the most, because it was used mainly in the previously mentioned games. Your requests have been answered - from today you can shoot soldiers and monsters also with an assault rifle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/dc74e510590388d4f71236cbc632312fe3e41702.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Weapon upgrade system:[/b][/h1]
Since we are already on a topic of a small amount of weapons - from today we are giving you the first iteration of the weapon upgrade system. Do you want to convert a revolver as a large, accurate weapon for long-range combat? Or maybe a shotgun for a small, fast cut to fight closely? It is now possible. We are giving you 12 upgrades for Nagant and 6 shotgun upgrades. Over time, we will add more elements to the system and enable improvement of the rifle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/ca91fab553f5d920f7f51d6a2afdcf29b4a2c810.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/8c9359a6449f9c61cba7c4d8341a84750dc1a1df.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Storage:[/b][/h1]
If we were to indicate one element of Chernobylite, the lack of which you complain about the most, it would be Storage. You have often argued that the ability to store equipment in the database is crucial for survival games. Because. although we planned to take care of it only next week, we have accelerated work and we are giving you the first iteration of storage now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/c97cdf2c420e34ba97ae885dbbaf15fe5700dedd.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]New crafting items:[/b][/h1]
Together with the introduction of new mechanics, we are also introducing items necessary for service. In the base building menu you will find 2 new tables that will allow you to upgrade your equipment. Storage type items will gain new functionality. In addition, you can build a rifle on the old tables from today
and ammunition for him.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/377367284315d606a6ae21996a728c4597fe4fee.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Rebuilding the quest "Meeting with Tarakan":[/b][/h1]
Although everyone loves Tarakan, you didn't liked the quest dedicated to him. A large number of placeholders combined with numerous issues didl not made a good impression. That is why we decided to finish it and rebuild it a bit. We hope you will enjoy it now.

[h1][b]New languages to choose from:[/b][/h1]
We added the first iteration of Czech and Ukrainian today. Both done by our community. Let me know how you like them.

[h1][b]Also we are currently doing some Developer Streams Daily! That means you can see some of our Developers actually playing the game and answering the questions. 

You can watch them here, on the main page of the Steam Store Page of Chernobylite: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1016800/Chernobylite/ 

Also you can follow us on Social Medias to be reminded about stuff. 

Get the daily pics on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/chernobylite/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Chernobylite...
Twitter: https://twitter.com/ChernobylGame
VK: https://vk.com/chernobylitegame
Discord: https://discord.gg/chernobylite
[/b][/h1]

notes.title: A month after the release of Early Access (AKA Monthly Report)
notes.content:
[b]A lot of things happened since the release. We’ve worked hard to fix the problems and bugs identified by the community, added a lot of improvements and increased the quality of the game itself. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/6ca7304579d4cdaca003e6d04fa9b4da18a588a9.png[/img]

In the next couple of weeks our team will be focusing mostly on Survival aspects of the game - the diversity of the gameplay elements as well as on extending gameplay. Remember, that the core of Early Access is cooperation with the players, in order to deliver the most fitted for their requirements game. We want you to be able to come back to Chernobylite with pleasure for as long as possible. We care about polishing those elements, to bring the Early Access phase to final shape. 

[b][i]We also encourage you to report the bugs and problems you’ve encountered during the gameplay on our Steam forum - https://steamcommunity.com/app/1016800/discussions/1/ - your feedback will really help us get rid of the issues you experience completely. 
[/i][/b]

If you have an opinion about Chernobylite in your mind, please write a review of the game on Steam. We are trying to reply to every one of them. We take into heart not only the things you like, but also the ones you think we should correct in the future. Thank you for all the reviews so far. Let’s keep up the good work guys!

[b]Work Progress so far: [/b]

[h1]Roadmap: [/h1]

At the very beginning, a week after the release, we announced our official Roadmap which reveals many details about the content you may expect in the upcoming months. Players were curious about the direction we will take for the game so we decided to announce what we are planning to do and when. Those who missed it can check the Roadmap below. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/0911a11e7e6ab1562ff12520022a061af22ae68e.png[/img]

[h1]Localization: [/h1]

We added couple of language localizations: Russian, Polish, German, Hungarian, French, Dutch, and Spanish. We also corrected the localization issues from the previous versions. Of course, we know that there are still some things that need to be corrected, but we are doing our best to fix them. 
We also added English voice-overs for those who prefer playing the game in English.

[h1]Save System: [/h1]

Some of you were experiencing problems with the save system, that’s why we modified how it works. From now on the game is also saved after every day, which should make your gameplay experience easier. You don’t need to hold on to the current save, you can start the day from the beginning, as well as go a couple of days back. 


[h1]Optimization: [/h1]

We added a lot of optimization fixes which will shorten the game’s launching time on different PC specifications. We also optimized the memory management system which corrected the issues with sounds and reduced loading times of the maps. The FPS count has raised a few % as well. “Ultra” settings are still a prototype but we stabilized their flow so that they can work on computers with lower specifications than before. 

The amount of space game requires is also reduced. This means that the patches from now on should be much smaller shortening the time necessary to download and install them.

[h1]Difficulty Level: [/h1]

Players had some problems with a too high difficulty level, that’s why we started implementing changes. We created a system which allows you to set up your difficulty settings on your own. There are 3 levels available: Survival, Combat and Base Management. Additionally, we added an option to skip the tutorials. 

[h1]Food Supplies: [/h1]

Many of you had argued about the quality of the repeatable missions. Therefore we fixed a lot of problems thank to your feedback. That means that the missions at current state are much more playable, and exciting. Let us know in the comments if you like it! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/9862f74bd6b9a1a0e7acbed58ce585a547770894.jpg[/img]

[b]Gameplay:[/b]

[h1]Scanner/PDA:[/h1]

Many of you asked us if we can correct the way the scanner works, to distinguish those items you are currently searching for from the other ones. You want it, you have it! Now the resources you select in the PDA menu are highlighted in green, while the rest of them are in yellow. It will allow you to easily search for what interests you most during exploration.

[h1]Chernobylite Storms:[/h1]

The players thought that the system in which the game limits the possibility of moving around the location for a long time is a bit too strict. As a solution we introduced an option to create a special device that allows you to extend the time between thunderstorms. We also got rid of the timer counting down the time to the next storm and allow the players to observe themselves how much time they have until the next storm. The Black Stalker appearing during a storm has been significantly weakened, making the survival of the storm easier.

[h1]Crafting:[/h1]

In terms of the crafting system we added a few very important items, which can be very useful during gameplay: 
- Q-Wave Generator which allows player to extend the time between storms.
- Adrenaline Shots to prevent Igor from dying. 
- Alcohol, which helps you regain the correct level of Psyche. 

[h1]Survival:[/h1]

First of all, we introduced a system allowing the game to go on forever. During the game, as you progress, it will be getting harder and harder to gather resources. Also due to the increasing level of radiation every day, animals that you can hunt to get food won’t appear as often as before.

[h1]Stealth:[/h1]

You commented a lot about the stealth system. We took it under consideration, divided it down into parts and corrected the general concept. Level design is now significantly improved in order to support stealth better. So far changes in this matter can be found in the Moscow Eye, Pripyat Port and in several places in Kopachi.

[h1]Psyche[/h1]

We started working on Igor's Psyche mechanics. Please keep in mind that these are prototypical solutions which are just the foundations for what we want to create eventually.
Igor's lack of solid food and hunger now causes mental decline.
When the psyche level reaches zero, Igor's health points will begin to decrease until he has 1 health point left. However, you can defend yourself from the damaging effects of starvation with the help of Alcohol, which you can create in your base.

[u][b]Other details about latest Chernobylite patches can also be found in the threads:[/b][/u]

Major update: Survival and stealth adjusted
https://steamcommunity.com/games/1016800/announcements/detail/1610527415446563562
Major update: customize your gameplay style 
https://steamcommunity.com/games/1016800/announcements/detail/1607150351605587307
Major Update: Food drops and Stealth
https://steamcommunity.com/games/1016800/announcements/detail/1607150984614261482

[h1][b]Community Related Informations: [/b][/h1]


[h1][b]Virtual Photography Contest (FINISHED)[/b][/h1]

In the meantime we held a virtual photography contest. The community response was amazing with dozens, if not hundreds of entries! The competition was really tight, but in the end we were able to choose the winner and we announced the results of the competition in the thread below:

https://steamcommunity.com/ogg/1016800/announcements/detail/1607150351605587307

That’s all for this update, we’ll meet soon in the “Weekly Report #2!” 

Chernobylite Team.

2019-11-06
Chernobylite Rev 21432 Patch Change Log

[b]Localization:[/b]
[list]
[*] The huge number of errors in the location have been corrected. There are still some mistakes, we know about them and we fix them soon.

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] We solved a problem that caused Tarakan's key to remain in inventory forever.
[*] We've fixed a rare bug that caused players to spawn under the level.
[*] Checkpoints on the Convoy quest should now work correctly.
[*] Mouse sensitivity settings should no longer reset after death.
[*] A lot of small bugs reported by steam have been resolved.
[*] Few smaller bugs related to level geometry have been resolved.
[/list]

[b]Difficulty Levels:[/b]
Our game is not yet in a place where you can balance every element well, which is why many of you complain that it is too easy or too difficult. To improve your game experience, we've decided to create a tool that will allow you to customize the game to your preferences. From today you can balance the level of difficulty in three categories - survival, combat and base management difficulty. Just start a new game. And in addition, so that you don't have to go through the power plant and all tutorials again - we've also added the option of skip them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/ae17966dff746db5552cb5353706256a74c612a0.jpg[/img]

[b]Scanner:[/b]
We have seen on streams that players have a problem with scanner detection. You ask, "If I choose raw material on it, why do they all light up?" We wanted to make players do not have to perform many scans, and at the same time could easily locate the raw material they are looking for. Navigation on the scanner screen was clearly not readable enough for you. Therefore, now we have changed the raw materials selection method. All raw materials are marked in yellow and those that we are looking for in green. This should help you a lot in your search:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/aa07efb4818bd2e91f95cdc5e5cdee81d716ca61.jpg[/img]

Changes that we have done in level design for combat and stealth have been warmly received by you, which is why we continue working in this direction. This week we've improved several more arenas:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/9098f00cdc41e5e57c5cb73d2277b93894cbe2d0.jpg[/img]

Let’s make it clear. We thought it’ll be an quite technical task, but it took us several days - so many amazing screenshots have been sent to us, that we spent quite a time on checking them all. Then it was even harder to choose the best pictures, because the quality of work you’ve delivered was simply astonishing. 

Today we can reward only few of virtual photographers, but we’ll take care to share your art and honor you within following weeks on our social media.

Eugeny Demidov [/h1]
for his depiction of Chernobyl liquidator:

Check more of his work in his galleries on Flickr ([url=https://www.flickr.com/photos/141192508@N07/albums/72157711471561538]https://www.flickr.com/photos/141192508@N07/albums/72157711471561538[/url]) and Twitter ([url=https://twitter.com/Jack1_1Hammer]https://twitter.com/Jack1_1Hammer[/url])

[h1]The next winners, who’ll receive the artbook and t-shirts, are…[/h1]

[h1]ItsYFP ([url=https://twitter.com/ItsYFP]https://twitter.com/ItsYFP[/url])[/h1]
for the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant heist screenshot:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/ae70909f6291ba8f0003e9741e91db778459f531.jpg[/img]

And good news for those who’d like to keep fighting on this ground. Looking at what you’ve provided, we’re sure this is not the last of our virtual photography contest.

notes.title: Major update: Survival and stealth adjusted + bugfixes and optimization.
notes.content:
[i][b]Important note: to make the whole game working smoother, updating faster and requiring less space on your hard drive, we've strongly altered and optimized the general structure of the game build. This means that with current patch you'll need to re-download the whole game content which is about 28 Gigabytes of data after compression. But from now you'll have more free space on your hard drive and the next patches will be smaller and more effectively downloaded and installed.[/b][/i]

[b]General fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] For everybody willing to make perfect screenshot or virtual photography without the game interface: we've added the option to disable UI using the CTRL + ALT + [ combination of keys. This shortcut disables the UI completely and permanently, to invert it you need to reload the game. We are working on a more elegant solution.
[*] Compression and Steam packages optimization made game build much smaller. Instead of 45 GB right now it should occupy about 30 GB on the disk.
[*] Not all gameplay mechanics were clear to you, especially those in Base and after death. We've added some new tutorials to explain them.
[*] Items and containers now have a small overlay that appears before we pick them up. This should facilitate scavenging and looting soldiers when several items are close by.
[*] Compass UI is a little more subtle.
[/list]

[b]AI and combat:[/b]
[list]
[*] Soldiers should now behave more naturally when they find the body.
[*] Takedown produces sound. Killing a few soldiers next to each other should no longer be possible.
[*] Black Stalker uses the laser and no longer shoots using debug tracing lines.
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Beating dolls should no longer cause a crash...
[*] Equipment size can no longer be expanded indefinitely.
[*] Tarakan should now appear correctly in the database when using retrospective branching.
[*] Exiting the game at transition levels should no longer cause damage to save if you do so after the indicator disappears.
[*] We've fixed a whole bunch of smaller bugs you have reported. Thanks!
[/list]

[b]Survival:[/b]
The flow of survival is one of the most important elements of our game. Unfortunately, not all of our design decisions were presented clear to you. Many of you asked, "why if the meaning of the game is to survive in Chernobyl, then the game lasts only 10 days?". Well, the game was not limited to 10 days, we rather wanted you to replay the story missions with branching and retrospections, which is best seen at repeated transitions. Today, we are not sure if this decision was correct. Therefore, as part of the experiment, we raise the limit to 100 days, additionally introducing several changes that should emphasize on survival aspect:
[list]
[*] Over time, Chernobylite storms are becoming more frequent. Build a Q-wave generator to defend against them.
[*] As a result of chernobylite substance activity, the zone is becoming more and more radioactive every day. Moving around it will be more and more difficult.
[*] Raw materials for crafting are slowly diminishing in the following days, which will result in fewer and fewer of them with time progress.
[*] There will be fewer and fewer animals over time. Hunting for food will be more difficult.
[/list]

[b]Stealth improvements: [/b]
We often hear from you that unfinished AI is one of the biggest problems of the game. However, the problem is much more complex. To make AI better, we also need to improve patrol roads, level design and many game balance parameters. So far we’ve chosen 3 places for testing. If you like it, we will improve the rest of the game in a similar way:

[b]Center of military base on Eye of Moscow:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/de8ca08a2fa18e4450bad422416e6d44fb46f6bf.jpg[/img]

[b]Near the hospital at Prypiat Port:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/47de7eb6878c798ddca3048b01e5b77566e4feec.jpg[/img]

[b]Western part of the resort on Kopachi:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/9862f74bd6b9a1a0e7acbed58ce585a547770894.jpg[/img]

[b]In addition, we have introduced the following changes in combat:[/b]
[list]
[*] When we hide in the bushes, they become slightly transparent. It's easier to move around and watch soldiers.
[*] New takedown animation. Only one at the moment, but it shows the direction in which we want to go. It is slower, more emotional and emphasizes more on the fact that Igor is not a killing machine.
[/list]

[b]Psyche system: [/b]
[list]
[*] We have finally started to work on this mechanics. Treat these solutions as prototypical, it's just a base for the future, which will ultimately hinder survival:
[*] Igor's lack of food allocation results in a decrease in Psyche
[*] When Psyche is at 0 the player starts to drop health points, down to 1 point.
[*] We've added the ability to craft alcohol in a laboratory that raises psyche.
[/list]

Remember about our virtual photography contest that ends soon:
https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791463995837/announcements/detail/1663444077006171888
Many stalkers already provided their great artwork, you can still contribute and win the trip to the real Chernobyl Zone with us!

notes.title: Weekly Report #1 - A week after Early Access launch.
notes.content:
Hey stalkers!

It’s been a long week. Likely the most busy and the most fruitful time in the whole project’s history. We’ve finally released the Early Access of Chernobylite on Steam and GOG and it was just the beginning of the next big stage for the project. Now we’re pushing hard to keep improving the game after the feedback gathered from all of you. And because the game became popular with so many players buying it and joining our communities, we’re both extremely happy and quite overwhelmed because of that much of the data to process nowadays.

Please keep playing the game and reporting us any suggestions, issues and ideas – we can’t always answer all of them in real-time, but we’re definitely reading all of them and trying to sort out for the execution of our work plan.

Last few days we’ve prepared and released 3 big patches with several additions, modifications, optimizations and improvements over the existing content. All according to your requests, bug reports, discussions on forums, and the reviews we’ve received. Among others, we’ve added many language localizations as this was one of the main requests: now you can play Chernobylite with English voices (at top of Russian that was already in game) and subtitles/interface in English, French, German, Spanish, Russian, Dutch, Hungarian and Polish. The next localizations are on their way soon. We’ve improved a lot the optimization thanks to your feedback and hardware reports, removed many crash-related issues (thanks to your bug-reports, again).  

The key question now would be – what next?

The most important: we plan to regularly update the project with three types of content packs:
[list]
[*]Monthly content updates: every month we want to deliver a huge content update, like a new weapon, location, gameplay feature, mission pack and so on. 
[*]Weekly updates: every week we plan to release a smaller patch with the fixes and improvements for the most important aspects of the project that deserve to be delivered as soon as possible (like yesterdays weekly patch with English dialogue voice-overs).
[*]Minor updates: without any time obligations, if we’ll see there’s something worth of throwing update just-in-time, we’ll do it (like it happened twice during last week with optimization and bug-fixes updates).
[/list]

Please take a look on the preliminary roadmap here once more if you missed it yesterday. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/0911a11e7e6ab1562ff12520022a061af22ae68e.png[/img]

The plans that we’ve originally had are a bit adjusted regarding the order of delivering you different content packs, but the overall game idea shaped earlier together with our Kickstarter backers remains intact. We definitely need to better address few fields of the project that was mostly reported as requiring more attention: AI, combat balance, technical issues, language implementation quality, save and progression system. We plan do add possibility to access different game areas more easily without need to restart the whole game. We’ll keep working on optimization and animations quality, as well as on soundtrack and overall gameplay balance. Basically, almost all of what we’ve done already makes us proud considering the time and budget we had, but personally none of us is 100% happy with the idea to stop fixing, improving and polishing the stuff. So expect small, but noticeable changes to keep popping-up all the time.

Stay irradiated!

notes.title: Major update + Roadmap
notes.content:
[b]Localization:[/b]
- We've added English Voice Over. The language of the voices can be changed in the game settings.
- Spanish language version has been added.
- The line about killing “single Russian” changed to non-offending.

[b]Chernobylite Storms: [/b]
Bad balance combined with bugs caused that this element is identified by you with time limit. Our goal has never been to make a time limit, but only to let you feel the breath of your main nemesis - the Black Stalker - all the time. We are listening to your feedback on this element of the game. That is why we have made the following changes:
- Now you can build a Q-wave generator in the base, which makes storm less common.
- The Black Stalker is now much weaker, and its appearance time has been reduced from 2 minutes to 30 seconds. Its AI and operation is a prototype. Will change in the coming weeks
- The clock has been turned off. Now, to know when the storm comes you must observe the sky and changes in the world.

[b]Optimization:[/b]
- Overall regardless of the settings, the game should work a few percents better.
- We've optimized the memory management method. This should resolve most sound issues and make levels load much faster. FPS drops will also be less frequent and less severe.
- We're working on Ultra settings. Although they are still a prototype, they should work much better on slightly weaker machines.

[b]Retrospective branching (also called “new game plus”):[/b]
- Collected evidence should no longer disappear after players death
- Player perks should no longer disappear after his death

[b]Improvements/Additions:[/b]
- Adrenaline can now be crafted in the base laboratory

[b]Fixes:[/b]
- Fixed an issue where players could get stuck during training with Mikhail
- Due to numerous errors and crashes related to hacking, we decided to temporarily disable it.
- We've fixed a bug that allowed you to gain unlimited experience during the Tarakan quest
- Quest Unearthed documents should now be a bit easier to complete.
- Fixed an issue that prevents Unearthed documents from being completed during the next attempt
- We've fixed several issues that caused the marker to not always work properly during the mission in Pripyat.
- We've fixed a whole bunch of smaller bugs you have reported. Thanks!


If you have any feedback for us, don't hesitate to give it. Finally, a small dessert - we finished work on our Roadmap. You can see it below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474429/0911a11e7e6ab1562ff12520022a061af22ae68e.png[/img]

notes.title: Chernobylite is available NOW! Early Access Launch!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Starting today, you have the incredible opportunity to breathe in the terrifying charm of the Nuclear Power Plant in Chernobylite.[/b][/h1] 

Okay, that wasn't a good choice of words. Chernobyl is definitely not a safe space to breathe anything in, BUT it is a great place to explore and fight hostile stalkers and weird multidimensional creatures, am I right? 

Additional information about language localization status:
The text implementation is still not finalized, some bugs in subtitle and interface display may occur. Our game is very text-heavy. It's the story-driven experience with non-linear narratives - meaning thousands of lines of dialogues and interface text even for an Early Access chunk. We keep pushing a lot to translate game into as many languages as possible, but we were not able to finish all the translations and to implement them before today. This is why Chernobylite on October 16th will be delivered with Russian voices and English, German and French subtitles. We're working on translating and implementing many other subtitles nowadays, being advanced with Polish, Russian, Dutch, Spanish, Swedish, Turkish, Italian and starting few others at top of it. The plan is to deliver them with micro-patches within the next few days after Early Access release.

If you agree, then take your survival kit and embark on an unforgettable journey for just [b]29.99 USD / 24.99 EUR / 23.99 GBP / 99 PLN / 249 UAH / 666 RUB[/b] through [b]Steam Early Access[/b] and [b]GOG “Games in Development”[/b].
Just don’t forget to watch the new trailer first, as this is not an all-inclusive type of a trip. You don’t want to go unprepared.

Explore the heart of darkness – the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant itself. Investigate the terrifying environments of Kopachi kindergarten, climb the mysterious Eye of Moscow, and inspect the fragments of the abandoned city of
Pripyat. 

[previewyoutube=uYjQZ2k2Hu0;full][/previewyoutube]

Experience 8 hours of constant survival and non-linear storytelling. Get access to free-of-charge updates that add new episodes, locations, characters, and equipment to the game. And if you’re determined enough,
discover all the possible endings!

Remember: it's an Early Access game. We're delivering it in the current state mostly to gather feedback from you and to shape the final experience with your help. If you feel anything should be changed, improved or fixed, don't hesitate to report it. We won't be able to answer directly to every notification, but we can assure you - we read all the feedback.

The main point of discussing the game and reporting the ideas and bugs is our Steam forum:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1016800/discussions/

And the second important channel, where we try to respond in real-time, is our official Discord server:
https://discord.gg/mehRmzY

The same as English voiceovers very soon, and Ukrainian voiceovers a bit later.

notes.title: Demo updated once again
notes.content:
We are very pleased with the positive feedback from you and we want to thank you for all the surveys you sent to us. We are now solving bugs with which you are flooding us every day and we are improving things that irritate you. Here is the newest demo update:

- We have added support for high resolutions, including 4k.
- FPS should be about 10% higher and a lot more stable. It may be not much, but it’s always a step forward.
- We have solved a lot of issues related to the broad FOV. Widescreen owners should be able to play now in greater comfort.
- Most of the problems with New Game and Continue that you have reported have been resolved.
- Random crashes that you have reported should now stop appearing ... or at least appear much less often.
- Evgeniy says the time limit for missions is irritating. It takes some time to refine this mechanics, but to reduce its irritation, we have increased the limit from 20 minutes to 30 minutes. Have fun exploring!
- We had to temporarily disable hacking. Do not worry, it will be back!
